trump-01.name: I · Le Bateleur
trump-01.Scene: A conjurer stands behind a table spread with small objects — cups, balls, a knife. He wears a wide-brimmed hat and a belted tunic. One hand gestures toward the table; the other holds a wand. The composition follows the standard Marseille Bateleur closely.

trump-02.name: II · Le Capitaine Fracasse
trump-02.Scene: A swaggering soldier in plumed hat, half-armour, and long cloak stands with one hand on his hip and the other on the hilt of a broad sword. His exaggerated posture and martial dress identify him as Le Capitaine Fracasse, the blustering commedia dell'arte captain.

trump-03.name: III · L'Impératrice
trump-03.Scene: A crowned empress is seated on a throne, wearing an ermine-trimmed gown. She holds a sceptre in one hand and an eagle-blazoned shield rests beside her. Her wings, common in many Marseille versions, spread behind the throne.

trump-04.name: IIII · L'Empereur
trump-04.Scene: A crowned emperor sits on a stone throne in near-profile, wearing armour and an imperial mantle. He holds an orb or sceptre. The throne is shown at a three-quarter angle typical of the Belgian/French Marseille tradition.

trump-05.name: V · Bacchus
trump-05.Scene: A portly, wine-flushed Bacchus sits astride or beside a wine barrel, raising a goblet. He wears a wreath of vine leaves, and grapes cluster around him. The scene is festive and deliberately secular, replacing the hierarchical Pope figure.

trump-06.name: VI · L'Amoureux
trump-06.Scene: A young man stands between two women; a winged Cupid above aims an arrow downward. The scene depicts the moment of choice or the pangs of love. The figures are dressed in Flemish-influenced costume.

trump-07.name: VII · Le Chariot
trump-07.Scene: A crowned warrior rides in a canopied chariot drawn by two horses. He holds a sceptre or sword. The canopy is decorated with stars; the two horses may differ in colour, pulling in divergent directions yet controlled by the charioteer.

trump-08.name: VIII · La Justice
trump-08.Scene: A crowned woman sits on a throne, holding an upright sword in her right hand and a set of scales in her left. She is shown frontally in the standard Belgian/Marseille Justice pose.

trump-09.name: VIIII · L'Ermite
trump-09.Scene: A robed elder walks slowly, bent over his staff, carrying a lantern in his raised hand. He is shown in profile or slight three-quarter view, moving across a plain ground.

trump-10.name: X · La Roue de Fortune
trump-10.Scene: A large wheel turns in the centre of the card. Figures cling to or are attached to the rim — one rising, one at the top, one falling. A sphinx or crowned figure may sit atop the wheel.

trump-11.name: XI · La Force
trump-11.Scene: A crowned woman in flowing robes gently opens or closes the jaws of a lion, her hands placed calmly on the animal's muzzle. The lion does not resist. The scene is tranquil despite the apparent danger.

trump-12.name: XII · Le Pendu
trump-12.Scene: A man hangs upside-down by one ankle from a wooden gallows or horizontal bar supported by two trimmed trees. His free leg crosses behind the suspended one, his arms are relaxed behind his back, and his expression is serene.

trump-13.name: XIII · La Mort
trump-13.Scene: A skeleton in armour swings a great scythe across a field, mowing down severed heads, hands, and limbs that grow from the ground. The figure moves relentlessly across the card.

trump-14.name: XIIII · Tempérance
trump-14.Scene: A winged angel pours liquid between two vessels — from one raised pitcher into another — without spilling a drop. The figure is standing, shown in a long-skirted tunic.

trump-15.name: XV · Le Diable
trump-15.Scene: A horned, winged devil sits or stands on a pedestal. Two smaller demons are chained to the base. The devil displays bat wings and a grim or leering expression. A torch may be shown inverted.

trump-16.name: XVI · La Foudre (La Maison-Dieu)
trump-16.Scene: A tall tower on a rocky outcrop is struck by a bolt from the sky; the crenellated crown is blasted off and flames erupt from the windows. Two figures fall headlong from the tower's height.

trump-17.name: XVII · L'Étoile
trump-17.Scene: A nude or lightly draped woman kneels beside a pool of water, pouring from two pitchers — one onto the earth, one into the water. Above her, a large central star is flanked by seven smaller stars.

trump-18.name: XVIII · La Lune
trump-18.Scene: A crescent moon, with a face, hangs in the sky above a path that winds between two towers toward distant mountains. A crayfish or crab emerges from a pool at the bottom. Two dogs or wolves howl at the moon.

trump-19.name: XVIIII · Le Soleil
trump-19.Scene: A large radiant sun with a human face shines down on two small children playing in a walled garden or open meadow. The children hold hands or embrace beneath sunflowers or stars.

trump-20.name: XX · Le Jugement
trump-20.Scene: An angel blows a trumpet from a cloud above; from tombs below, three figures rise — man, woman, and child — with arms outstretched toward the angel. The figures are typically coloured red, flesh, and blue.

trump-21.name: XXI · Le Monde
trump-21.Scene: A dancing figure — commonly understood as androgynous or female — is enclosed within an oval wreath of laurel. At the four corners of the card are the four tetramorph symbols: angel, eagle, lion, and bull.

trump-22.name: Le Fou (The Fool)
trump-22.Scene: A ragged, carefree figure in colourful patchwork costume walks toward the edge of a precipice, a bundle on a stick over his shoulder. A small dog or cat nips at his heels. He gazes upward or forward, oblivious to the drop ahead.

axis-atouts.name: Les Atouts (22 Trumps)
axis-atouts.Scene: The twenty-two trumps of the Belgian Tarot laid out together. The sequence follows standard Marseille ordering with the two Protestant substitutions — Capitaine Fracasse in place of the Papesse, and Bacchus in place of the Pope — both rendered in vivid hand-coloured line engraving.
